metadata.description: The audiobook app for your inbox.

hero.heading: Your inbox, read aloud.
hero.body: MailFlow listens to your inbox for you. Skip, archive, and reply with a word — no scrolling, no tapping.

signIn.title: Sign in with Google
signIn.body: One consent screen connects your account and your inbox — nothing else to set up.

startListening.title: Say “start listening”
startListening.body: MailFlow picks up exactly where you left off, even if that was days ago.

listen.title: Listen, one paragraph at a time
listen.body: It reads each email aloud, then pauses to ask what's next — you're never stuck mid-message.

sayTheWord.title: Say the word
sayTheWord.body: ”Skip,” “archive,” or “reply.” No typing, no tapping required.

commandShowcase.heading: Four words, hands-free
commandShowcase.body: The same vocabulary works whether you’re speaking or tapping — say it, or touch it.

closingCta.heading: Close your eyes. Listen. Say a word.
closingCta.body: Free to start — connect your Gmail and hear your first email in under a minute.

signIn.consent: By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

openAiKey.heading: OpenAI API key
openAiKey.freeTrial: Free trial — {remaining, number}/100 free actions left
openAiKey.description: MailFlow uses its own OpenAI key for your first 100 actions for free. Once you''ve used your free allocation (or any time, if you''d prefer), you can add your own key. You''d only be covering your own OpenAI API usage costs — MailFlow isn''t a paid plan.

inbox.heading: Inbox
inbox.freshSessionNote: Changing scope or order starts a fresh session the next time you listen.

autoSkip.heading: Auto-skip while listening
autoSkip.description: Silently skip past emails in these categories instead of reading them aloud.

playbackSpeed.heading: Playback speed
playbackSpeed.description: How fast emails are read aloud. Applies immediately, on the listening screen too.

voiceTone.heading: Voice tone
voiceTone.description: Optional hint for how emails are read aloud — for example, "a little more upbeat" or "slower pace."
voiceTone.placeholder: No special tone — calm and unhurried (default)

account.heading: Account
account.confirmBody: This revokes MailFlow''s access to your Gmail and signs you out. You can reconnect any time by signing in again.

onboarding.heading: Add your OpenAI key
onboarding.body: You''ve used your 100 free actions. To keep using MailFlow, add your own OpenAI API key.
onboarding.notPaidNote: MailFlow isn''t being paid for this — you''re just covering your own OpenAI usage so we don''t have to fund it indefinitely.
onboarding.apiKeyEncryptedNote: Your key is encrypted and stored securely.
onboarding.findKey: Find your OpenAI API key in your <link>account settings</link>.
onboarding.billingDocs: Read OpenAI''s <link>billing documentation</link> to understand your usage and costs.

overview.heading: 1. Overview
overview.body: MailFlow (“we”, “us”) is an audiobook-style reader for your inbox. This policy explains what data we access, how we use it, and how you can control it.

googleUserData.heading: 2. Google user data
googleUserData.intro: When you sign in with Google, MailFlow requests access to your Gmail account through the Gmail API. We use this access only to:
googleUserData.bullet1: Read email content and metadata (sender, subject, body) so it can be read aloud.
googleUserData.bullet2: Perform actions you request by voice or command, such as archiving, replying to, or snoozing a message.
googleUserData.outro: We do not use Gmail data for advertising, and we do not sell, rent, or share your Gmail data with third parties. Gmail data is used solely to provide the MailFlow experience to you.

otherData.heading: 3. Other data we collect
otherData.body: We store your Google account identifier and basic profile information (name, email address) to maintain your session, along with app settings and playback state you create while using MailFlow.

storageAndSecurity.heading: 4. Data storage and security
storageAndSecurity.body: Data is stored using industry-standard security practices. Access tokens are used only to communicate with the Gmail API on your behalf and are never exposed to third parties.

retentionAndDeletion.heading: 5. Data retention and deletion
retentionAndDeletion.body: You may revoke MailFlow''s access to your Google account at any time from your <permissionsLink>Google Account permissions</permissionsLink> page. To request deletion of any data MailFlow has stored about you, email <emailLink>harrison.thomas04@gmail.com</emailLink> and we will delete it within a reasonable time.

thirdPartySharing.heading: 6. Third-party sharing
thirdPartySharing.body: We do not sell your personal data or Gmail data. We do not share it with third parties except as required to operate the Service (e.g. infrastructure providers bound by confidentiality obligations) or as required by law.

changes.heading: 7. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

contact.heading: 8. Contact
contact.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to <emailLink>harrison.thomas04@gmail.com</emailLink>.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using MailFlow (the “Service”), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the Service.

description.heading: 2. Description of service
description.body: MailFlow connects to your Gmail account to read your inbox aloud and let you manage email (skip, archive, reply) by voice or simple commands. The Service is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis.

yourAccount.heading: 3. Your account
yourAccount.body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your Google account and for any activity that occurs through your use of the Service. You may revoke MailFlow''s access to your Google account at any time from your <permissionsLink>Google Account permissions</permissionsLink> page.

acceptableUse.heading: 4. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to use the Service for any unlawful purpose or in any way that could damage, disable, or impair the Service or interfere with any other party''s use of it.

disclaimer.heading: 5. Disclaimer of warranties
disclaimer.body: The Service is provided without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. We do not guarantee that the Service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free.

limitationOfLiability.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
limitationOfLiability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, MailFlow shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Service.

changes.heading: 7. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

contact.heading: 8. Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to <emailLink>harrison.thomas04@gmail.com</emailLink>.
